en: A black-and-white photograph showing a line of uniformed soldiers posed with rifles in front of a brick building. The soldiers are wearing pickelhaube helmets, a distinctive spiked helmet associated with the Prussian and German military in the late 19th and early 20th centuries. There is a drummer in the foreground and several officers standing apart from the group. The scene appears formal, possibly a ceremonial guard or changing of the guard outside an official or governmental building.
